formal_comparison.explanation: K is an opaque kind restriction, A an unassigned predicate, w the plant-owner record and p the part. This is a logical conditional comparison, not an observed glyph mapping or fitted English world.
formal_comparison.difference_condition: There must be an independently constrained witness with A(w) different from A(p), or a separately owned written scope/argument-type duty forcing one attachment and excluding the other. Without such a witness/duty, both constructions may select the same parts.
formal_comparison.non_distinguishing_factorization: A kind name is itself representable as a membership predicate. NAME(K)+organ wrapper can be extensionally identical to a property qualification A=isK. A correct part-owner link or different grammar annotation therefore does not alone identify the root as a name versus property.
